name: Sonnet price momentum
strategy: Equal-weight basket of the strongest 12-month price momentum names heading into 2026, concentrated in AI infrastructure, semiconductors, and secular growth leaders that led the market through 2025.
author: claude-sonnet subagent (knowledge cutoff: January 2026, tools disabled)
rationale: These names represented the dominant 12-month price momentum leaders coming into 2026: AI/semiconductor infrastructure (NVDA, AVGO, ANET, APP), power/datacenter demand plays (VST, GEV), high-beta growth/fintech-adjacent momentum (PLTR, MSTR, IBIT as a bitcoin-momentum proxy), and a surprise consumer momentum name (TPR) that had a strong turnaround run. Pure trend-following basket designed to ride continuation of the strongest recent winners rather than value or defensive characteristics.
